text:
Sofia: throwing this up for feedback 1: new Autoscale mock where min/max lives in a compact row and burst is a pill. Concern: when fallback happens, it's easy to miss.
Ravi: can you paste the mock?
Sofia: inline image: /img/mock-autoscale-compact-v3.png (note: pool selector top-left, SLO slider below)
Priya: first thought 1: add a persistent status badge next to the pool name (small pill) that changes color and has hover details.
Tom: +1. Also we should show a small delta next to the SLO 'achievable' label when fallback is active, e.g., "Achievable: ~85% (+120ms)" so users see impact without opening details.
Nora: copy pushback: ops doesn't like speculative exact ms in the main UI. Could be misleading for short sequences. Maybe show qualitative badges in-situ ("degraded"/"ok") and keep numbers in a details flyout.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: badges must include aria-labels, color should not be the only indicator, and provide focusable details.
Ravi: design compromise: small qualitative badge in-row: "Fallback: Degraded" with warning icon; on click expand a panel with ranges, causes, and remediation CTAs.
Sofia: thinking about placement: should badge sit after pool selector or after the burst pill? If burst caused fallback we want the user to connect the two.
Priya: place it after pool selector and include a secondary line in the details that shows "Triggered by: Burst" when relevant. Keeps placement stable and details contextual.
Tom: interaction notes: when fallback first triggers, animate the badge with gentle pulse and set keyboard focus to the badge region once per session. Avoid stealing focus repeatedly.
Nora: a11y: ensure the initial announcement is via aria-live="assertive" only for first time, then polite for updates. Include visible text change and an offscreen live region for screen readers describing the cause.
a11y-bot: suggested pattern: role="status" aria-live="polite" for updates; use aria-atomic on the snippet. For initial trigger use an assertive offscreen alert.
Sofia: copy options: 1) Badge (short): "Fallback: Degraded" 2) Hover title: "Traffic routed to hosted runtime; latency may increase" 3) Details header: "Fallback due to capacity constraints" 4) Details body: "When Dedicated pool is saturated, requests fall back to Hosted. Typical latency change: +50200ms depending on seq length. See perf guide."
Ravi: prefer shorter badge text. Move ranges to details. Add link to 'Reserve capacity' and 'Preview cost' CTAs in details.
Priya: UX edge: if user hovers over burst pill and badge is present, show microcopy that ties them: "Burst triggered fallback". Also keyboard users should be able to open micro tooltip via focus.
Tom: visual tweak: use a 3px orange left accent on the compact row and a 12px warning icon (not full background color). This keeps the compact density.
Nora: color contrast: make sure warning icon's foreground meets 4.5:1 on small sizes or accompany with bold text.
a11y-bot: recommend using both icon + text and ensure the clickable badge has aria-expanded and aria-controls that point to the details region id.
Sofia: analytics ask: track events when badge shows, when details opened, and whether user follows Reserve capacity CTA. Add metric names in the ticket.
Ravi: dev note: details panel should be reusable across fallback reasons (region, model-variant, burst) and list each with a short note.
Priya: copy tweak: instead of 'Degraded' maybe 'Fallback active' is clearer and less negative. The qualitative indicator can be 'Reduced performance'.
Tom: agree 'Fallback active' + a small secondary 'Reduced performance' sublabel.
Nora: will run quick screen reader flows on the prototype. Call out any timing issues with the assertive announcement.
a11y-bot: final recommended attributes snippet: "role=\"region\" aria-live=\"polite\" aria-label=\"Autoscale fallback status\"" and badge button: "aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"fallback-details-<id>\""
Sofia: decisions summary: - Badge next to pool selector: text 'Fallback active' + sublabel 'Reduced performance' - Badge uses icon + text (not color-only) - Badge opens accessible details panel with ranges, causes, CTAs (Reserve capacity, Preview cost, Adjust SLO) - Initial trigger uses a one-time assertive announcement and then polite updates - Reuse details component for different fallback reasons and list them as bullets - Instrument events on show/open/CTA click
Ravi: I'll add implementation ticket with the attributes and events. Priya will update mocks with the orange left accent and compact badge.
Priya: will post updated frames by EOD and include hover/keyboard states.
Nora: will test when frames are up.
Sofia: perfect, thanks everyone :rocket:
